proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists Oriya pathara stone under prastara. The survey pəthəṛə is the same regional form with the source’s central vowels and rhotic. The entry separately marks several Punjabi-mediated Hindi/Bihari forms as loans; that instruction is not extended to this explicitly listed Oriya reflex.
